Fabulous Seafood in Vung Tau with great service
Oct 2023 • Friends
A Vietnamese friend and I went to Vung Tau for a couple day break from Saigon.

We came to this restaurant for our second evenings seafood dinner. We sat right by the sea. We arrived a little late, just after 8pm and hour before the kitchen was due to close, so to be fair not everything we selected was available as they try to keep only fresh seafood so they don’t hold any excess. Nevertheless what we selected was spot on. Our waiter was super friendly and efficient and made suggestions and liaised with the chef on what could be prepared. She truly went above and beyond with her service. We definitely did not experience any bad attitude or negative service. I find if you are polite & respectful the service is always good in Vietnam. 

The highlights for me was a surprisingly Thai style prepared squid dish which was sublime. Baked oysters and scallops were also amazing but most of all were the super large sea snails prepared two separate ways were sensational. Even the seafood rice dish was delicious . 

We did not order any alcohol and just drank bottled water. Total bill including tip was just on 2 million, super reasonable for the quality and location.

They are right next to the Mercure hotel on the coast at Vung Tau. Next time I would like to come here for a long lunch to enjoy the scenery and just stay next door! 
Well worth eating here.

To be avoided !!!!!!!!!!!!
Mar 2023 • Friends
Hello everyone, 
I'm not one to leave reviews of restaurants, but this time I had to. 
Where to start? 

I recently visited the "Marina club" restaurant in Vung Tau for dinner and was very very disappointed with my experience. 

First of all, the service was slow and inefficient. Despite the fact that the restaurant was not very busy that day, it took more than 30 minutes for us to get our drinks. 
Indeed, there were 5 of us ordering and 3 of the 5 drinks were not the ones we had requested. It took about 20 minutes for the waiter to understand that the drinks were not the right ones. So yes, there is a language barrier but no effort was made by the waiter to try and understand our request (we are French and we make the effort to communicate in English). 

Concerning the food, it took about 30 minutes for our food to arrive. Same as for the drinks, out of the 5 dishes ordered, 3 were wrong (we had to do it...). 
On the menu we were offered 2 types of hamburger, one with cheese and one without. We made it clear that we wanted the cheese and of course they were without cheese. The waiter took our dish and only added a slice of cold industrial cheese (not melted ("tostinette" for the experts)).

Furthermore, the quality of the food was very disappointing. Our food was cold and badly prepared, with an unattractive presentation. 

Finally, it was time to pay. And yes, against all odds they managed to get the bill wrong. The prices did not match the items we had ordered beforehand so the prices were wrong. Again, we spent 45 minutes recalculating on our own the right bill with the right dishes but especially the right prices !!!!!!! 
All this without being understood, don't forget !!!!!! 

We arrived at 6pm and left at 10pm. Shame on you!

In conclusion, despite our complaints about the quality of the food and service, the staff didn't seem to care and didn't offer any solution to rectify the situation (they offered us vouchers that had a multitude of conditions, so they were unusable).

 Overall, my experience at the Marina Club restaurant was very, very disappointing and I would not recommend this restaurant to other customers.

I would suggest that the restaurant review their service and food quality, and provide additional training and English classes to their staff to improve their efficiency and customer service. In addition, I suggest that they consider preparing the food to order to ensure optimum quality

Yours sincerely.

Typical poor quality vietnamese style
Aug 2020 • Friends
We were invited here by our vietnamese friends who regularly go here. On arrival there's no parking area, you have to leave your car on the street 30 meters away. The greeting was professional and pleasant and a table was found for the six of us. Slight delay on ordering drinks but we got there, and we ordered a variety of main courses to share. No problem there. A couple of issues, despite being next to the sea it was uncomfortably hot. 
 My main issue was the quality of food, it just didn't match the surroundings. It was just average vietnamese style food not cooked particularly well. But the prices were certainly not average. Quite expensive for what you were getting. 
 Would I go again? No. There are better places in vung tau than this.

I attended a private engagement party of 18 pax. It was a bad experience for us, especially for the couples who are getting engaged. 
The food was good, the waitstaff was polite, service was OK, nothing to complain. 
However, the worse parts come from the Sales Manager (Ms. Hoa) and a so-called "Restaurant Manager". (Mr. Tu' - #4) 
Ms. Hoa, to me, is not up to standard for even a Sales Executive. She has the worst attitude ever. She appeared at the ceremony with a frowning face, and God knows why. When the welcome sign fell from the A-frame and hit her hand a bit, she just threw the thing on the floor and walked away cursing out. We almost wanted to tell her that we do not want to see her face. 
Then she also did not deliver what was promised to the guests, and worst of all, argued with the groom and bride.
The Manager did not help, but made it worse. They were not trained, or simply did not care about anything at all. It might be because they are so arrogant, I am not sure. 
There was not even an apology or checkup or anything that resembles SERVICE.
It's just a location where guests think they do not have a choice but to go there. 
For us, this is the first and also last.

Absolute five star in every area
Jan 2020 • Solo
Just driving past on the old scooter and thought that looks a nice place for breakfast! 

I was greeted by a lovely young lady who took me down in the lift and seated me, when a bit of translating became too much for her the general manager come over and introduced herself and she was so so nice, we had a good conversation (totally forgetting about asking her to explain the menu😂) 

She offered to show me around after my breakfast and provided me with her business card if I needed to get in touch.

Breakfast was great and service exceptional as usual in Vietnam... after I was shown around by the general manager, the spa and facilities and then by the assistant to some rooms which are absolutely first class... really really stunning, looking out on the ocean! 

I booked myself in the next day for a sabai massage got 1 hour and half hour extra for free (happy hour) and it was an amazing massage... just what I needed, sauna and steam and jacuzzi before followed by the very professional and efficient massage, she really knew exactly what she was doing.

I’ll be coming to stay here when I’m back in a week or two, it’s worth the treat!

You can not go wrong here and if anything does go wrong I’ve no doubt at all that Magdalene the manager will do everything to assist and solve, really nice lady... so would like thank her and ALL the staff I interacted with for their hospitality 

Vang tau also has a bit of everything, the perfect place for anyone and everyone
